changeSet.author: bassner
changeSet.comment: Estimate historical costs from the stored tariffs, interpreted as EUR under the old Artemis contract. Use one fixed ECB reference rate, 1 EUR = 1.0968 USD on 18 November 2026 (https://data.ecb.europa.eu/data/datasets/EXR/EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A). Cache reads and writes are included in the total input count and priced separately. Require valid counts and rates for every used token type and at least one positive used rate. Rates above 1,000,000 EUR per million tokens are rejected as invalid, as are NaN and infinity. Zero tariffs are accepted alongside positive ones; an all-zero tariff may mean prices were never configured.

column.name: total_cost_usd
column.valueComputed: ( (CASE WHEN (num_input_tokens * 1.0 - num_cached_input_tokens - num_cache_write_input_tokens) > 0 THEN (num_input_tokens * 1.0 - num_cached_input_tokens - num_cache_write_input_tokens) * CAST(cost_per_million_input_tokens AS FLOAT(53)) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN num_output_tokens > 0 THEN num_output_tokens * CAST(cost_per_million_output_tokens AS FLOAT(53)) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN num_cached_input_tokens > 0 THEN num_cached_input_tokens * CAST(cost_per_million_cached_input_tokens AS FLOAT(53)) ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN num_cache_write_input_tokens > 0 THEN num_cache_write_input_tokens * CAST(cost_per_million_cache_write_input_tokens AS FLOAT(53)) ELSE 0 END) ) * 1.0968 / 1000000.0

update.where: total_cost_usd IS NULL AND cost_source IS NULL AND num_output_tokens >= 0 AND num_cached_input_tokens >= 0 AND num_cache_write_input_tokens >= 0 AND (num_input_tokens * 1.0 - num_cached_input_tokens - num_cache_write_input_tokens) >= 0 AND ((num_input_tokens * 1.0 - num_cached_input_tokens - num_cache_write_input_tokens) = 0 OR cost_per_million_input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND (num_output_tokens = 0 OR cost_per_million_output_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND (num_cached_input_tokens = 0 OR cost_per_million_cached_input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND (num_cache_write_input_tokens = 0 OR cost_per_million_cache_write_input_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND ( ((num_input_tokens * 1.0 - num_cached_input_tokens - num_cache_write_input_tokens) > 0 AND cost_per_million_input_tokens > 0) OR (num_output_tokens > 0 AND cost_per_million_output_tokens > 0) OR (num_cached_input_tokens > 0 AND cost_per_million_cached_input_tokens > 0) OR (num_cache_write_input_tokens > 0 AND cost_per_million_cache_write_input_tokens > 0) )
